{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for rows with NaN in revenue
missing_revenue_rows = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()]

# Display these rows
print(missing_revenue_rows)

# Check the 'status' and 'converted' columns for these rows
temp = missing_revenue_rows[['status', 'converted']]
print(temp)

# Check the distribution of 'status' and 'converted' in the full dataset
print("\nFull dataset status distribution:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())
print("\nFull dataset converted distribution:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
